description: This file defines data types, function prototypes, and API functions related to pattern parsing and evaluation in the Lighttpd server. It includes type definitions for pattern representations, callback functions, and functions for creating, freeing, and processing patterns.

methods.name: li_pattern_new
methods.description: Constructs a new pattern object by parsing a given string, returning NULL on error.

methods.name: li_pattern_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a pattern object.

methods.name: li_pattern_eval
methods.description: Evaluates the pattern with a given request context, appending the result to a string.

methods.name: li_pattern_array_cb
methods.description: Default callback for array patterns, expects an array of GString elements.

methods.name: li_pattern_regex_cb
methods.description: Default callback for regex patterns, expects a GMatchInfo object.

ctags.name: liPatternCB
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*liPatternCB) (GString *pattern_result, guint from, guint to, gpointer data);$/
